MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish cage? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish cage.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish cage.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish cage.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish cage.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Physiology? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Physiology.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Physiology.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Physiology.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Physiology.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Marketing? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Marketing.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Marketing.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Marketing.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Marketing.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
